fusions.name: Brace and Bash
fusions.desc: Slams forward and deals 32 damage, leaving the target 25% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Last Stand Flail
fusions.desc: Flails at every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 8 damage. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%. It holds 3 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Hold the Line
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 30% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Guard Up
fusions.desc: Against a target afflicted with a condition, your armour rises 12%.
